objective: Ensure read-only identities can browse only their bound synthetic tenant through shared Next.js/Edge authorization and downstream role-based selectors, even if a role is misconfigured as SUPER_ADMIN, while preserving ordinary SUPER_ADMIN support and deliberate demo browsing.
current_evidence: getCallerAdmin permits a read-only SUPER_ADMIN GET request to override its bound tenant.
canAccessBusiness grants any SUPER_ADMIN all tenants without considering auth.readOnly.
Routes such as OTA GET accept a foreign query selector whenever the shared helper returns SUPER_ADMIN, even without an x-admin-business-id header.
The actual demo provisioner sets MAIN_ADMIN; this correction protects the invariant against role drift without changing that account.
behavior_to_preserve: Read-only demo users can browse their own synthetic tenant.
Read-only users remain denied by mutating Next.js and Edge boundaries.
Non-read-only SUPER_ADMIN users retain validated cross-tenant support.
The synthetic date refresh and customer-facing chatbot configuration remain unchanged.
forbidden_behavior: Read-only cross-tenant access through a role or browser-selected tenant
Changing database migrations before ledger/order validation
acceptance_tests: Read-only SUPER_ADMIN own-tenant GET/browse remains permitted.
Read-only SUPER_ADMIN foreign header target is denied by getCallerAdmin, and its downstream effective role cannot authorize a foreign query selector.
The actual getCallerAdmin result composed with OTA GET permits the own tenant and denies a foreign tenant before service-client access.
Read-only SUPER_ADMIN foreign target is denied by canAccessBusiness.
Writable SUPER_ADMIN validated foreign target remains permitted.
Existing demo read-only and synthetic-refresh tests remain green.
existing_customer_cases: No identity, role, business relationship, record, password, or commercial setting is changed.
Ordinary platform support retains its existing foreign-tenant access.
rollback_strategy: Source rollback only; never restore or rewrite customer data.

result.scope_limit: Partial SEC-11 only; database/RLS/Storage and deployed evidence remain open.
